title: Never Step Outside
hook: What if you never step outside ever?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU
NEVER GO OUT

beats.label: 1 DAY
beats.line: Your skin turns pale, missing the sun's warm, golden daily hue.
beats.idea: Close-up of the character's face, skin fading to a pallid tone as a dim sun icon fades.

beats.label: 3 DAYS
beats.line: Your internal clock drifts, making you feel sleepy at midnight every night.
beats.idea: Inside the brain, a pineal gland clock spins off‑beat, the character yawns under a night‑light.

beats.label: 7 DAYS
beats.line: Vitamin D plummets, so bone cells begin to soften and weaken.
beats.idea: A cartoon cross‑section of a bone shows porous spots, calcium icons disappearing.

beats.label: 14 DAYS
beats.line: Serotonin drops, and your mood flattens, feeling as flat as a pancake.
beats.idea: Brain illustration with serotonin droplets draining, the character's expression becomes flat.

beats.label: 30 DAYS
beats.line: Your immune cells shrink noticeably, leaving you vulnerable to everyday colds.
beats.idea: White blood cells shrink in size as tiny virus cartoons approach the character.

description: A quick look at how staying indoors harms body systems.

facts.claim: Lack of sunlight reduces melanin production, leading to paler skin.
Insufficient natural light disrupts circadian rhythm, causing sleep disturbances.
Vitamin D deficiency from no sun exposure weakens bone mineral density.
facts.source: NIH, Vitamin D and Bone Health

facts.claim: Reduced sunlight exposure lowers serotonin, contributing to low mood.
Vitamin D deficiency can impair immune function, increasing infection risk.

end.line: So, would you ever stay indoors forever?

topic: What happens if you never go outside?
